newsitem.title: USA: U.S. soybean weekly export sales highlights -- USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. soybean weekly export sales highlights -- USDA.

text.p: USDA soybean export sales highlights in latest reporting week:

Net sales of 616,600 MT were off 45 percent from the prior week and 42 percent from the 4-week average. Major increases for China (185,400 MT, includes 9,600 new sales, 180,900 destination changes, 5,100 cancellations), Japan (185,200 MT), Germany (163,400 MT, includes 46,600 new sales, 120,900 destination changes) and the Netherlands (149,800 MT) were partly offset by reductions for unknown destinations (295,300 MT) and Turkey (19,200 MT).

Exports of 895,800 MT were 2 percent short of the previous week, but 13 percent above the 4-week average. The primary destinations were China (185,400 MT), Germany (126,300 MT), the Netherlands (111,500 MT), and Japan (98,900 MT).
